statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The symptoms are episodic in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I49.9, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
